buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PR NO : 1100006008 1. Specifications: High speed precision drilling machine with all electrical cap.6mm spindle with ER 11 colle t pre-loaded spindle, min. 6000 RPM manually operated. • Drilling cap.6mm (max.) • Spindle travel 50mm (max.) • Distance between spindle nose and table min/ max. 55 / 205mm (Appx.) • Distance between column and spindle axis 125mm (max) • Size of table with machined edge 330 x300 mm (Appx.) • No of T slots 1 no’s • Spindle max speed 6000 RPM (min) • Feed Hand/manual • Motor cap. 0.5Hp /1370 RPM • Power source 415 V ±10%, 50Hz, 3 Phase AC Accessories: • 12 collets range from 0.5-6.5 mm • Coolant equipment with all fittings - 01 no. • Drilling stand cum cabinet - 01 no. Spares: • Flat belt - 01 no. • Handle Spring - 2 nos. • Spindle bearing - 1 set (02 nos.) • Housing Spring - 1 set (02 nos.) • Spindle washer - 2 set (07 nos. each set) Small changes in the drilling machine specifications is acceptable based on the standard specifications of t he OEM. 2. Prove-Out & Acceptance during Technical Bid of the tender: During Technical evaluation, M/s. BDL will c all you for the prove-out the parameters. Vendor has to bring the drilling machine to BDL –KBU and prove o ut the parameters with BDL Article. Once qualified only, Vendor will be considered for next process.

3. Acceptance Test: (a) PDI to be done at OEMs’ or Supplier Premises. Calibration certificates also needed to provided from ISO /NABL accredited lab. Wavier can be given to PDI by BDL QC. (b) After supplied to BDL-KBU, Vendor need to prove accuracy & repeatability of drilling machine with BDL article. Repeatability of min 3 iteration needs to be done with BDL article. (c) Final acceptance will be provided by BDL QC after successful installation, demonstration and training. 4. Training: Installation & Training should be provided at free of cost pertaining by the vendor in BDL prem ises in offline mode. 5. Documentation (Hard copy): (a) Machine Operation manuals: 3 sets (b) Installation & Commissioning manuals: 3 sets (c) Maintenance manuals: 3 sets (d) Soft copies of above need to be provided. 6. Vendor should provide OEM authorization letter along with technical bid. 7. Vendor should provide User Manual for the item. 8. Quoted items OEM should have service center in India. 9. Delivery schedule: within 08 weeks from the date of receipt of Purchase order. However early deliveries are also accepted. 10. Warranty: All items as a part of Drilling Machine shall be covered by warranty for a period of 36 month s from the date of acceptance of material at BDL, Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad at free of cost. 11. Replacement for the rejected items to be provided on priority basis at free of cost. 12. Annual Maintenance contract (AMC): After warranty the party should agree for AMC for a period of 10 y ears and separate service order will be provided by BDL separately. 13. In case of breakdown, during the warranty period, the firm shall depute their service personnel along w ith necessary spares and make the equipment in working condition within 24 hours from the time of intima tion at free of cost. 14. (a) The supplier shall ensure to reach the items with the required quality to BDL through adequate pac kaging without any damage. Identification/Traceability number should be marked on each Item. (b) Any damage or missing parts, vendor is liable and need to replace the same at free of cost. (c) The components should be free from Defects & Damages. (d) Packing & Forwarding: Items should be securely packed as per the delivery/Traceability list standard sp ecification/ guidelines for severe road transport conditions and packing charges to be borne by the supplie r only. 15. The components shall be delivered to BDL stores (F.O.R BDL, Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad, Telangana St ate-500058) at free of cost. 16. Payment terms: (a) 90% basic value + taxes will be paid within 30 days after receipt and acceptance o f items at BDL. (b) Balance 10% will be paid against submission of Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) for 5 % PO value v alid till warranty period plus 3 months claim period. (c) In case of non-submission of PBG, 10 % payment will be released after satisfactory completion of warra nty period only. 17. Security deposit: Security deposit shall be submitted by the successful bidders for 5% of the order valu e (by way of Online payment / Demand Draft / Bankers Cheque / bank guarantee from scheduled banks) wi

thin one week from the date of purchase order and valid up to successful execution of the order till the last delivery date as per purchase order plus 3 months claim period. SD will be released after successful compl etion of the order and against submission of performance bank guarantee as applicable. 18. Price Quoted: Free of cost at BDL Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad: i.e., inspection, packing & forwarding, frei ght insurance etc. are in supplier scope only. 19. (a) Bidder shall quote for all the items and full quantity of each item. (b) The evaluation will be done considering all the items as a set and L1 will be arrived based on overall lo west for the set. (c) Quotation for partial items/ partial quantities will not be considered. Supplier shall not supply non-confo rming product/Items against specification. 20. Supplier shall retain the product related records (Processes, Quality Records etc.) up to 3 years. 21. The Successful bidder will be debarred / blacklisted for the future tenders for a period as decided by B DL, if the bidder deviates from the agreed terms & conditions after the award of Purchase Order / Work Or der / Service Order apart from forfeiture of your EMD. 22. Benefit of ITC Clause: Benefit of Input Tax Credit should be passed on to BDL without fail. Benefit of re duction in rate of GST applicable for the supply, compared to the rate of GST as per the Contract, should b e passed on to BDL without fail. A Certificate duly signed by the Company Secretary/ Director/ CFO/ Manag ing partner/ Proprietor, as the case may be, should be furnished along with the quotation in the following f ormat. “Certified that the benefit of input tax credit and /or rate reduction has been duly and commensurat ely passed on in terms of section 171 of the CGST Act.” 23. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 24. Option clause: BDL retains the right to place orders for additional quantity up to 100% of original order ed quantity at the same terms and conditions (at the same rate). 25. BDL reserves the right to process and finalize the tender among the technically acceptable offers by co nducting on-line e-reverse auction ( after opening the price bids) and bringing all vendors to equal level pla ying field in respect of techno-commercial conditions or may finalize the tender without e-reverse auction , if required by BDL. The process adopted for e-reverse auction is at the discretion of BDL. The details of auc tioning will be given to the vendors in advance and familiarization will be arranged for the same, if require d. 26. The Prices indicated in the PO (After finalizing the bids and release of PO) are firm and fixed i.e., no sub ject alteration / variation on any account unless specified in the purchase order. 27. LD Clause: “Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to th e delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, withi n the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Inclu ding duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part there of, subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be bor ne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor”. 28. All Other Terms & conditions are applicable as per the General / Limited Terms and conditions attached . . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card.
b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.
